vaults.name: Who reads web-summit.sgit.ai: the published data
vaults.what: observability@web-summit.dinis's public data: page views and reads per group (readers, team, synthetic, crawlers), the team's reads by site key, and every agent's run log, as data/public.json, refreshed by the hourly drain; with the app (index.html) that renders it. No anonymous row. The private vault it is drained from (kuuqr3do) is not published.

vaults.name: Who reads web-summit.sgit.ai: the app (Dinis's)
vaults.what: The observability app, code only: one self-contained index.html that reads data/public.json over the vault bridge. Its source is people/dinis/observability/app/index.htm.

vaults.name: The stand reel
vaults.what: The twelve approved stand videos from the team's videos vault (h9in5em4, kept by video@web-summit.silvio), every language and format, cut into 4-second fragmented-MP4 pieces under 4 MB so the command centre's VÍDEOS view (assets/cc/demo.js) plays them in the browser through the vault's read API. Content unchanged, re-encoded at 1080p. reel.json lists them.
